content:
It’s a party in the U.S.A. — Miley Cyrus got hitched!

The singer, 33, tied the knot with musician Maxx Morando, 28, in a ceremony in Palm Springs, California, on Saturday.

The happy couple said their “I do’s” at Frank Sinatra’s former estate in front of about 100 guests who attended their big day, according to TMZ.

Cyrus shared a first-look of her wedding photos in an Instagram post on Sunday. In a carousel of images, the “Hannah Montana” alum, who wore a white long-sleeve silk Saint Laurent gown by Anthony Vaccarello, and a tuxedo-clad Morando, cozily posed together.

In another image, the pair shared a kiss on a flower-covered aisle as their wedding guests applauded.

Cyrus simply captioned the post, “M + M 🤍 11.21.26.”

Representatives for Cyrus didn’t immediately respond to HuffPost’s request for comment.

Cyrus and Morando’s star-studded nuptials were reportedly attended by Miley’s mom, Tish Cyrus; her dad, Billy Ray Cyrus; and her sister, Noah Cyrus. Billy Ray’s girlfriend, Elizabeth Hurley, and her son, Damian Hurley, also attended the ceremony.

The wedding came a year after multiple outlets confirmed the couple’s engagement in December 2025. The “Flowers” singer has been romantically linked to Morando since December 2021.

Cyrus revealed that she met the Regrettes musician on a blind date in an interview with British Vogue in May 2023.

She clarified to the magazine, “Well, it was blind for me and not really for him. I thought, ‘The worst that can happen is I leave.’”

A source close to Cyrus gushed to People about the singer’s relationship with Morando in February 2024.

“She is very happy with him,” the insider said of Cyrus. “Miley has changed a lot in the past couple of years. She seems more calm and harmonious. Everyone loves Maxx. He’s a great guy. He’s private and doesn’t like being in the press. It’s been good for her.”

Cyrus was previously married to actor Liam Hemsworth from December 2018 to August 2019. The ex couple finalized their divorce in 2020.
